subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw accept an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` method that writes UTF-8 text under resolved session workspace roots from the Control UI?
rationale: The PR adds a new Gateway mutation path for session workspace files, which changes the operator security boundary beyond a routine UI enhancement.

options.title: Accept after boundary repair
options.body: Fix image byte sniffing, rebase onto current main, and then approve the admin-only writer as the intended session workspace edit surface.

options.title: Narrow the writer
options.body: Require saves to be limited to previewed or transcript-touched text files if arbitrary in-root text creation is broader than maintainers want.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Close or pause this PR if session workspace editing should remain outside core Control UI for now.

recommendation.title: Accept after boundary repair
recommendation.body: Fix image byte sniffing, rebase onto current main, and then approve the admin-only writer as the intended session workspace edit surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main adjacent workspace file reader with the relevant security-boundary comments and sniffing behavior.
